harper: :loudspeaker: Alert — az-east1 maintenance window to apply NIC microcode and small kernel stability patch. Planned staggered rolling reboots across 5 cohorts. Window: 2026-09-10 01:30-05:30 UTC. Aim: remove p99 jitter and prevent short-lived scheduler churn.
li: cohort sizes? estimated per-cohort duration?
harper: cohorts ~9 racks each (~8% region capacity). Per-cohort 15-25m (cordon -> graceful drain -> reboot -> kvcache warm -> smoke probe). Full window includes buffer for manual verification.
noah: dedicated/private pools impact?
harper: dedicated pools (tagged `private-east`) are opted-out by default. If autoscaler cannot keep headroom, jobs will land on pre-warmed us-west burst nodes — transparent to tenants. We'll notify top tenants and add console banner.
oncall-bot: Maintenance event created: https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-east1-1844444444 (01:30-05:30 UTC)
li: runbook checklist snippet? drain command and preheat steps?
harper: short runbook: preheat 10m before cohort start; cordon node; drain with grace 240s; reboot; after node ready run `kvcache-prime --region az-east1 --cohort $C --shards 10 --parallel 6`; golden probe: `curl -fsS https://ops.redwood/health/az-east1/cohort/$C | jq .p95` must be <160ms before uncordon. If probe fails, keep cordoned and fail traffic to eu-central fallback.
noah: rollback thresholds? cost estimates for fallback?
harper: rollback: stop further cohorts immediately, keep affected cohort cordoned and route to eu-central. Auto-failover triggers after 90s of healthcheck failures. If fallback runs for full window worst-case, finance estimate ~$3k; charge code infra-maint-2026.
li: enable high-res tracing and increase metric scrape to 10s for the window. Also run a low-QPS mirrored smoke job after uncordon.
oncall-bot: Observability toggles applied: traces=high-res, scrape=10s for az-east1 from 01:10-05:50 UTC.
harper: I'll post full playbook in /runbooks/az-east1-nic-stability.md and pin here. Ryan or Noah will be oncall for window; please join 10m early. Thanks :white_check_mark:
